task_origin_contract.rule: A free-discovery output cannot lose its candidate lifecycle by being repackaged as an ordinary taskbook. An audited free candidate may be published directly by a researcher, but raw Phase-A candidates remain non-dispatchable.

obvious_stage_continuation_rule.pattern: STAGE integer >= 2 in task_id or title
obvious_stage_continuation_rule.reason: Stage numbering is explicit continuation semantics and may not be relabeled NEW_DIRECTION to bypass the successor gate.

task_lineage_contract.semantic_anti_evasion_rule: Even without Stage naming, if the parent result is a necessary research premise/motivation and the new task is the next unresolved layer of the same mother route, classify it CONTINUATION. Renaming does not reset lineage.
task_lineage_contract.rule: PASS or DONE on a parent task is not itself evidence for a successor. A CONTINUATION publication requires a genuine new information gap, falsifiable outcomes, kill condition and alternative-route/free-exploration consideration.

runtime_terminal_contract.rule: Publishing or freezing one task never silently closes the parent objective.

runtime_lease_contract.rule: Taskbook or scheduler lease minutes preserve ownership; they never prove the current conversation is alive.

optional_metadata.identity_lane: compact human-readable lane such as R012, R005C, P017
optional_metadata.parent_task_id: required when task_lineage=CONTINUATION; otherwise normally null
optional_metadata.successor_gate: required when task_lineage=CONTINUATION; otherwise normally null

manual_dispatch_identity_gate: After registered publication, a Driver-mediated manual relay may preallocate a Researcher-ID outside the taskbook; registration always precedes handoff.
rules: A taskbook defines task-specific work; the registry defines whether that work officially exists as a publishable/claimable task.
All publishers use one mandatory publication template and one canonical registry.
A researcher may publish a claimable task without Driver approval after machine policy/lineage/origin checks pass.
Researcher publication defaults to P2/MEDIUM runtime rank while preserving the publisher's priority/leverage request; Driver may later reprioritize globally.
Publication never grants Working Truth, Foundation status, theorem truth, canonical promotion or Driver authority.
Every published task declares a nonempty parent_objective_id so task ownership cannot become orphaned from the runtime parent loop.
Every registry record contains research_value so valuable residues are preserved even when not immediately selected.
FREE_AXIOM_CANDIDATE publication is allowed directly from audited candidate states; raw Phase-A candidates remain non-dispatchable and cannot be laundered into another origin.
CONTINUATION requires parent_task_id and a complete successor_gate; stage numbering or parent PASS is never a substitute.
Taskbook generic repository policy is inherited rather than copied into the mathematical body.

Task-specific temporary overrides cannot weaken theorem truth, safety, ownership, candidate provenance, successor gates, registry requirement, runtime terminal scope, stale-adoption integrity or final permission.
Taskbooks never bind a fixed runtime Researcher-ID. Publisher identity belongs to the registry record; execution identity belongs to owner/session runtime state.
A stale replacement conversation adopts the existing owner claim after durable-frontier verification; registry publication does not manufacture a second execution identity.
A taskbook STOP/FREEZE is TASK-terminal by default and returns the controlling runtime to the parent objective.
Researcher publication of a side residue is capture, not an automatic switch away from the current task.
recommended_flow: prepare a taskbook with tools/research_task_records.py prepare or the approved equivalent
edit only task-local content and complete any successor gate
run optional structural lint with tools/research_taskbook.py audit
publish one immutable V2 task record with publisher identity and research_value
require tools/research_task_records.py audit PASS for the new transaction
only then claim or dispatch the task
after publication, return to the current parent objective
